topic: Adjusting session duration for analytics models
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating the frequency calculation formula and adjusting session time parameters for analytics models. The primary decision was to change the standard session duration from 8 hours (currently used on both staging and production) to a 2-hour interval, specifically for 'Transport Hub' data and general transit analytics.

[me] confirmed copying the model to production after [p1] updated it on staging. A discrepancy regarding session length was identified: while the standard process uses an 8-hour aggregation, the new requirement is a 2-hour interval. To correct this, [me] agreed to write and run a script to reaggregate the data on the staging environment.
decisions: The analytics model must be updated with a 2-hour session duration for production.
A script will be written and executed by [me] to reaggregate the staging data using the correct 2-hour interval.
action_items: [me] to write and run a script to reaggregate the model on staging with the 2-hour session duration.
